def transform2(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0]); k=min(n,m)//3
    # Move each 3-cell-wide marker to the far edge opposite its long zero tail.
    if any(0 in row for row in grid):
        horizontal=sum(row.count(0) for row in grid[:k]) >= sum(row.count(0) for row in grid[-k:])
        # Test is vertical: compact blocks at the bottom and tails upward.
        vertical_blocks=sum(grid[r].count(0) for r in range(n-k,n))
        vertical_other=sum(grid[r].count(0) for r in range(n-k))
        if vertical_blocks>vertical_other:
            cols=[c for c in range(m) if any(grid[r][c]==0 for r in range(n))]
            out=[row[:] for row in grid]
            for c in cols:
                vals=[grid[n-k+i][c] for i in range(k)]+[7]*(n-k)
                # retain the long stem: it is the zero in the non-block part
                stem=[grid[r][c] for r in range(n-k)]
                # bottom block moves up; the stem shifts below it
                vals= [grid[n-k+i][c] for i in range(k)] + stem
                for r,v in enumerate(vals): out[r][c]=v
            return out
    return [([7]*(m-k)+row[:k] if 0 in row else row[:]) for row in grid]
